# Original particle submission fixtures

The input file contains 192 sprite submissions previously captured from
unchanged original `224550`, with eight explicit vertex-attribute bindings.
Half retain the original `23ECD0` bindings 1 through 8; half use deterministic
permutations to check the separate binding input. The expected file contains
each complete 46-word packet written by unchanged original `23ED30`.

Generated by `tools/export_title_particle_submission_oracle.py` using XBE SHA
`03215919bb7163259257d361f4c7bf802a7ab12aa85e2689436369b5c427935d`.
The allocator at `15D00` alone is intercepted to supply writable memory; the
initializer and all submission instructions execute in the original image.
The report records the fixture and sprite-input hashes. The fixture input SHA
is `c1882830dcfed477f7613b820f66332511daf7fecd32e0c606266d5489561733`.

The actual ABI passes geometry in EBX, UV A on stack argument 7, and UV B on
stack argument 8. The recovered C prototype gives the pointer arguments in a
different order and must not be used as evidence of those bindings. Default
attribute 3 receives UV A; attribute 6 receives geometry. Packed color is
submitted unchanged; this check does not establish GPU normalization.

CTest compares every packet word with the independent original records.
Emission, simulation, declaration selection, GPU arithmetic, transparent draw
ordering, and framebuffer parity remain separate requirements.
